title: Lab-only receptionist never receives required lab.result.published event for own walk-in order
actual: Fresh own Lab-only order req1/patient11 created by demo.reception, RBS result1 entered by demo.labtech then independently verified Published by demo.labverifier. Reception screen stays Live but keeps PendingVerification/LAB_REPORT_NOT_READY after publication. MCP sandbox_events reception from0 with topic lab.result.published returns no events cursor299; verifier from270 returns publication299. get_event audience says ordering doctor + lab verifiers, while get_screen_bundle lab_only_walkin explicitly requires this event to refresh signed report. A walk-in has no ordering doctor. Lab technician similarly sees neither pending298 nor published299 despite bench bundle event handling.
expected: Deliver the required publication hint to authorised Lab-only reception readers/requester (and clarify technician subscription expectations), scoped to their permitted data. Do not require client polling or falsely report a signed report before an actual read. Our UI has the required handler and manual refresh; missing role event delivery blocks automatic report handover.
